in_marathi.name: Madhavi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of wealth, beauty
in_marathi.long_meaning: Madhavi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Madhavi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Madhava', which means 'God of wealth'. In Hindu mythology, Madhavi is also associated with the goddess Lakshmi, the deity of wealth and prosperity. This name is a symbol of beauty, abundance, and good fortune.

vedic_reference.root_origin: Sanskrit, Goddess of wealth and mother of Lord Krishna
vedic_reference.note: Madhavi is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Madhava', which refers to Lord Krishna himself. In Hindu mythology, Krishna is often depicted as the god of wealth and abundance. The name Madhavi is thus a tribute to both the divine mother and the divine son.
